posts.zh:
DeepSeek-Harness-Desktop#desktop-launcher-plugin 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。在设置页加入「桌面端」卡片，检测 DeepSeek Harness 桌面应用并一键唤起。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-6e7c37f69ff6342fa6d1.html
posts.en:
DeepSeek-Harness-Desktop#desktop-launcher-plugin is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Adds a Desktop card to the settings page that detects the DeepSeek Harness Desktop app and launches it with one click.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-6e7c37f69ff6342fa6d1.html
